name: Costa Rica (state flag, 1824–1840)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of light blue, white and light blue, with the arms of the Federal Republic of Central America in the centre of the white stripe and the seal of the Free State of Costa Rica in the centre of the lower blue stripe.
history: State flag of Costa Rica as a member of the Federal Republic of Central America, adopted on 22 November 1824: the federal blue-white-blue triband with the federal arms in the centre and the state's own seal added on the lower stripe. It remained in use until 15 November 1840, after Costa Rica had left the disintegrating federation.
